Market today: Election Day is the big driver, with potential for market jolts if Democrats sweep. Tech stocks are already showing weakness, with Apple and Palantir sliding after earnings, and the AI bull market needing a tech recovery to keep going.

Your holdings: Almost everything is flagged "SELL" and many are deep in the red. SOXL is down a staggering -69.67%, MUU -42.78%, and SMCI -30.63%. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. CRWD is your only strong performer at +38.23%.

Watch: Keep a close eye on election results and how they impact broader market sentiment, especially for your tech-heavy book. Also, watch for any further weakness in major tech names.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your deeply underwater and leveraged positions amidst market uncertainty.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is completely out of touch with the current price of 68.17 and your -69.67% loss. Re-evaluate this stop immediately to protect remaining capital.
QQQ: Your stop at 670 is very close to the current price of 681.09. Be ready to act if it breaks, as this could signal further market weakness.
SQQQ: Consider a small hedge against your tech concentration. The scanner shows a long setup for SQQQ (entry 42.03-41.95, stop 41.39).
